title: Is context engineering the new analytics engineering?
description:
How Checkr cut an hours-long metrics investigation to minutes by engineering AI context on dbt and Omni. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Chris Merrick, co-founder and CTO of Omni, and Sarah Fischbach, staff analytics engineer at Checkr, ask whether context engineering is the new analytics engineering. Connecting an agent directly to a 6,000-model Snowflake and dbt project gave a different wrong answer each time. Their model of AI-readiness has three layers: the warehouse (the dictionary), the semantic layer (the grammar that prevents metric drift), and AI context. With synonyms, SLA targets, and edge-case rules encoded, an agent cut an investigation from hours to minutes.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why a semantic layer alone isn't enough for AI agents
• The three layers of AI-readiness
• How Checkr built a feedback loop for AI context

Speakers: Chris Merrick, Omni; Sarah Fischbach, Checkr

Read more: Context engineering is already possible in your warehouse. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/context-engineering-in-your-warehouse
